title: Profile
description: Governance configuration in the Shapes Context Protocol. Profiles define lifecycle statuses, gate conditions, field requirements, versioning schemes, and amendment rules that shapes and constraints must follow.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this profile.

description.description: Prose description of the governance policy this profile represents.

version.description: Semantic version string tracking the evolution of this profile.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of this profile (e.g. proposed, canonical).

intent.description: Structured declaration of what governance goals this profile serves.

provenance.description: Origin and authorship records for this profile.

lifecycle.description: Custom lifecycle definition: which statuses exist and what gates control transitions between them.

fields.description: Field declarations that shapes and constraints governed by this profile must or may include.

versioning.description: Versioning scheme and bump rules for nodes governed by this profile.

amendment_rules.description: Rules governing how amendments are applied to nodes under this profile.

amendment_log.description: Ordered list of Amendment IDs that have modified this profile.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to this profile.

Lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
Lifecycle.description: Defines the set of statuses a node can occupy and the gates that control transitions between them.

statuses.description: Custom status definitions available to nodes governed by this profile.

gates.description: Transition rules controlling when a node may move from one status to another.

StatusDef.title: StatusDef
StatusDef.description: Definition of a custom lifecycle status.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this status means.

Gate.title: Gate
Gate.description: A transition rule between two lifecycle statuses. Defines preconditions that must hold before the transition and postconditions that must hold after.

from.description: Source status name for the transition.

to.description: Target status name for the transition.

preconditions.description: Conditions that must be satisfied before this transition is allowed.

postconditions.description: Conditions that must hold after the transition completes.

ProfileFields.title: ProfileFields
ProfileFields.description: Field declarations for shapes and constraints governed by this profile. Specifies which fields are required, optional, or have constrained values.

shape.description: Field declarations that apply to shapes governed by this profile.

constraint.description: Field declarations that apply to constraints governed by this profile.

FieldSection.title: FieldSection
FieldSection.description: Field declarations grouped by the section of a node they apply to.

intent.description: Field declarations for the intent section.

status.description: Field declarations for the status section.

constraints.description: Field declarations for the constraints section.

realization.description: Field declarations for the realization section.

evidence.description: Field declarations for the evidence section.

provenance.description: Field declarations for the provenance section.

metadata.description: Field declarations for the metadata section.

FieldGroup.title: FieldGroup
FieldGroup.description: A group of field definitions within a section, covering fields, kinds, and sources.

kinds.description: Allowed kind/type values for this section.

sources.description: Allowed source values for this section.

FieldDef.title: FieldDef
FieldDef.description: Definition of a single field within a profile's field declarations.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this field is for.

type.description: Expected data type for this field (e.g. 'string', 'integer', 'array').

required.description: Whether this field must be present on governed nodes. Defaults to false.

Versioning.title: Versioning
Versioning.description: Versioning scheme configuration for nodes governed by this profile.

bump_rules.description: Rules describing when and how version numbers should be incremented.

AmendmentRules.title: AmendmentRules
AmendmentRules.description: Rules governing how amendments are applied to nodes under this profile.

application.description: Strategy for applying amendments: 'merge' deep-merges changes, 'overlay' replaces top-level fields, 'edition' creates a new version, 'append-only' only allows additive changes.
